text.en:
Section three of Act Numbered Thirty-three hundred and fifty-two, as amended by section two
of Act Numbered Forty-two hundred and sixty-one of the Philippine Legislature, known as the City Lowland
Improvement Act, is repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 23, 1938.
